label: Geometric representation
subgoals: Read the diagonal as the sum

visual.title: Addition is the diagonal of a parallelogram
visual.caption: Drag either arrowhead and change k. The sum follows the parallelogram, and scaling b by k stretches the same direction or reverses it.

predict.question: With k = -1, how does k b compare with b?
options: The same length, pointing the opposite way
predict.explain: Multiplying by a negative scalar keeps the line and the length but reverses the direction, so k b = -b.
